validations: AC-01: validate protected requirement — A repository with no usable default-branch head still uses the existing deterministic two-commit Parallax initializer and exact non-force default-ref update.
AC-02: validate protected requirement — An exact existing Parallax two-commit baseline is still fully verified, read-only, and reused as the branch base. No canonical invariant is weakened.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — An empty-tree head with the fixed Parallax cleanup message but wrong actor, parent, bootstrap marker/blob/provenance, or ref identity fails `GREENFIELD_BASELINE_MISMATCH` and is never treated as an ordinary empty commit.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — An ordinary existing default-branch commit whose exact tree SHA is `4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904` is used directly as the branch base. `repository.initialize-empty` is not invoked and the default branch is not mutated.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — If a run with a durable greenfield root reaches delivery after the target default branch has become non-empty, publication fails before branch/commit/PR mutation rather than silently rebasing onto unrelated source.
AC-06: validate protected requirement — Malformed/missing repository metadata, default branch, ref object, head SHA, commit payload, tree SHA, or mismatched repository identity fails closed.
AC-07: validate protected requirement — If the default ref changes between initial inspection and classification read-back, delivery fails before accepted-source publication.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — For an admitted commit-bearing-empty base, Parallax still creates only the bounded feature branch, commits the exact accepted lineage, creates/reads the PR, creates/reads a Vercel Preview, persists the delivery record, and remains at REVIEW.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — An already persisted successful delivery record for the same run/accepted lineage replays without additional provider mutation. Existing branch/PR/Preview idempotency semantics are unchanged.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Tests and diff prove no new provider permission, credential, network, model, command, execution profile, source-lineage, force-ref, merge, production, or automatic REVIEW authority.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — The exact spec passes validation plus authentic DSPy SpecCritic/SpecCompiler and strict compiled-plan validation before semantic implementation. Focused tests, full API regression, Bounded Autonomy, Workstream Spec Validation, and P2 CI pass on exact reviewed heads.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Exact merged API source reaches production READY with normal preflights, `/health` and `/ready` HTTP 200 and reviewed exact-deployment runtime scans. The same frozen W9-S1 run at REVIEW revision 12 retries publication of replacement lineage `src:001736ab731e243956cf78ede7a0087d2b81595f1008568850eac1e9acc3e809` against the commit-bearing-empty `parallax-qa1/main` without `GREENFIELD_BASELINE_MISMATCH`, creates/reads the bounded delivery artifacts or reuses them idempotently, and remains at human REVIEW.

critique: The source-delivery classification exposed after the production-accepted P2-V0.23.41 REVIEW rework. A repository whose canonical default ref exists and points to a commit with the canonical empty Git tree is commit-bearing and therefore already has a valid branch base. It must not be treated as a truly empty repository requiring Parallax's deterministic two-commit greenfield initializer.

P2-V0.23.41 is production-accepted on exact API source `78b408a2323ab474c3183a64d55c6399f5b20402`. Frozen W9-S1 Engineering Run `a64d56b7-ad42-42ad-9562-891783363f4a` accepted bounded REVIEW findings for `AC-03` and `AC-05`, re-entered PLAN from REVIEW revision 6, invalidated the prior selected candidate, regenerated from accepted lineage `src:da5d0fb62d34a3228bb56e7a7d82971c8023a536d11944ba71bcaa51a407b871`, accepted replacement lineage `src:001736ab731e243956cf78ede7a0087d2b81595f1008568850eac1e9acc3e809`, passed BUILD/TEST/VERIFY, and returned to REVIEW revision 12 with `last_failure_code=null`.

The later REVIEW publication attempt failed independently as event sequence 31: - provider: GitHub; - action: `repository.initialize-empty`; - result: `GREENFIELD_BASELINE_MISMATCH`; - run remained REVIEW revision 12. The exact target state is commit-bearing. `Ryan9876/parallax-qa1/main` points to commit `b24c029be916f8b1f0ab07347a988f814cc8d567`, message `Remove temporary P2-V0.23.40 acceptance baseline`, whose exact tree SHA is the universal Git empty tree `4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904`. The root cause is confirmed in `GreenfieldVerifiedLineageDelivery.deliver()`: whenever the accepted lineage descends from a durable `greenfield` root, delivery unconditionally invokes `initialize_empty_baseline()`. `GreenfieldGitHubClient.initialize_empty_baseline()` interprets any existing default-branch head as a purported Parallax canonical baseline and calls `_verify_baseline()`. An ordinary commit-bearing empty head therefore fails `GREENFIELD_BASELINE_MISMATCH` even though it is already a valid Git branch base.

The classifies a repository whose canonical default ref exists, the referenced commit is read successfully, its exact tree SHA is the canonical Git empty-tree SHA, and it is not admitted as a Parallax canonical-baseline candidate. The exact current head becomes the ordinary branch base for bounded accepted-source publication. No initializer/default-ref mutation occurs.

The exact repository/default-ref/commit/tree identity is mandatory. Malformed/missing repository metadata, default branch, ref object, head SHA, commit payload, tree SHA, or mismatched repository identity fails closed.
Concurrent default-ref movement fails closed before accepted-source publication.
Existing branch/PR/Preview idempotency semantics are unchanged.
Tests and diff prove no new provider permission, credential, network, model, command, execution profile, source-lineage, force-ref, merge, production, or automatic REVIEW authority.

The exact merged API source must reach Vercel production READY with normal production preflights; `/health` and `/ready` must return HTTP 200 and exact-deployment runtime warning/error/fatal scans must be reviewed; the frozen W9-S1 run at REVIEW revision 12 must retry source publication against the existing commit-bearing-empty target without `GREENFIELD_BASELINE_MISMATCH`; accepted replacement lineage must remain exact and the run must remain at human REVIEW; only after that evidence may `CURRENT-STATE.md` record P2-V0.23.42 as production-accepted and #570 close.
